entries.name: PostgreSQL

license.evidence: Official PostgreSQL distribution and Docker Official Image

entries.scope: Development database, Stage 2 metadata persistence, and later durable runtime candidate
entries.security: Local credentials only; production secrets remain outside source control
entries.maintenance: Major version 16 is fixed; patch and image digest updates require a registry change
entries.boundary: Domain modules access PostgreSQL only through repository ports
entries.replacement: Replace the PostgreSQL adapter without changing module contracts
entries.recheckTrigger: PostgreSQL major upgrade or managed database migration

entries.name: Ajv JSON Schema validator
entries.scope: Strict runtime validation for versioned command, event, and query payloads
entries.security: Schemas are trusted repository artifacts; untrusted remote schemas are not loaded
entries.maintenance: Exact resolved version is checked against package-lock.json
entries.boundary: Ajv is encapsulated by packages/contracts SchemaRegistry
entries.replacement: A replacement validator must pass the same SchemaRegistry and connector tests
entries.recheckTrigger: JSON Schema draft change or validator replacement

entries.name: garrytan/gbrain
entries.scope: Minion retry, timeout, idempotency, PostgreSQL locking, Page input, and namespace patterns
entries.security: No gbrain runtime, database, or provider configuration is embedded in Shotgun
entries.maintenance: Pinned v0.42.58.0 validation baseline; upstream changes are not consumed automatically
evidence: Minion lock and timeout recovery evidence
entries.boundary: Any future reuse must sit behind Shotgun Job, Repository, or Module ports
entries.replacement: Current in-memory runtime remains removable; durable queue evaluation occurs before persistent jobs
entries.recheckTrigger: Before Stage 6 persistent Inbox, Outbox, or durable Job implementation

entries.name: lucasastorian/llmwiki
entries.scope: Watcher and reconcile patterns for future directory intake; transformation helpers for Stage 3+
entries.security: Path-based source identity must not cross the Shotgun Source boundary
entries.maintenance: Pinned commit only; no runtime dependency added
entries.boundary: Watcher events may call Intake ports but cannot own Source identity
entries.recheckTrigger: When directory watching or Stage 3 transformation begins

entries.name: ddsyasas/llm-wiki
entries.scope: Source intake form, action-centered home, and presentation hierarchy
entries.security: Backend is excluded because of SSRF and arbitrary absolute-path workspace risks
entries.maintenance: 195 tests passed and 1 external smoke test skipped at the pinned baseline
entries.boundary: Only UI patterns may consume Shotgun typed APIs; backend and storage remain excluded
entries.replacement: UI can be rebuilt from the recorded workflow without carrying upstream runtime code
entries.recheckTrigger: When the Shotgun Web UI and Source Intake screen are implemented

entries.name: Inkeep OpenKnowledge

license.evidence: GPL v3 LICENSE at the pinned commit

entries.scope: Editor mode switching, 2D graph, activity, and diff UX patterns
entries.security: No runtime embedding or code copying into the current MIT-compatible product boundary
entries.maintenance: Pinned validation baseline; license impact must be re-reviewed before any code reuse
entries.boundary: Canonical data, approval, and Job state remain owned by Shotgun
entries.replacement: Patterns are independently reimplemented behind Shotgun APIs
entries.recheckTrigger: Before editor or graph UI implementation

entries.name: OpenTelemetry JavaScript
entries.security: Payloads and secrets must remain excluded from exported telemetry
evidence: current in-memory trace context meets Stage 1 contract tests
entries.recheckTrigger: First multi-process deployment or external telemetry backend

entries.name: OpenAPI Specification
entries.security: No public API compatibility promise is made in Stage 1
evidence: Stage 1 currently exposes an internal demo assembly
entries.recheckTrigger: Before a public or separately deployed HTTP API

entries.name: AsyncAPI Specification
entries.security: No external broker is active in Stage 1
evidence: in-memory and in-process transports are the current scope
entries.replacement: Connector contracts remain independent of the documentation format

entries.name: CloudEvents
entries.security: Shotgun security and provenance fields are not removed to match CloudEvents
entries.recheckTrigger: When a third-party CloudEvents consumer is added

entries.name: Temporal
entries.security: Operational service and worker footprint is outside the MVP
evidence: Stage 1 has no long-running workflow requirement
entries.replacement: Connector and Job contracts remain transport-neutral
entries.recheckTrigger: When timers, sagas, or multi-day workflows are required

entries.name: NATS JetStream
entries.scope: External event bus and durable consumers
entries.security: Broker operation is outside the single-process MVP
evidence: current transports pass the shared Connector contract
entries.recheckTrigger: When independent workers or event retention are required

entries.name: Redis Streams

license.evidence: License changed across Redis versions; exact version review is required before adoption

entries.security: No Redis service or credentials are introduced
evidence: not needed by the Stage 1 in-process MVP
entries.recheckTrigger: Only with an exact version, license review, and queue benchmark

entries.name: fsspec
entries.security: Adding a Python runtime bridge would enlarge the Stage 2 attack and operations surface
evidence: AssetStoragePort has only put and read operations
entries.replacement: Use small TypeScript adapters behind AssetStoragePort
entries.recheckTrigger: Only if a Python transformation service already becomes mandatory

entries.name: MinIO

license.evidence: Official repository; deployment and distribution model must be reviewed

entries.scope: Object storage for large or remote deployments
entries.security: Stage 2 uses local development storage only
evidence: current maximum asset size is 1 MiB
entries.recheckTrigger: Before remote deployment, multipart upload, or large asset support

entries.name: Apache Tika
entries.scope: MIME detection, metadata, and broad text extraction
entries.security: Complex document parsing requires isolation and a golden corpus
entries.maintenance: No JVM service added in Stage 2
evidence: Stage 2 accepts only direct text, UTF-8 txt, and plain-text md
entries.replacement: Current intake validates the explicitly declared narrow media types

entries.name: Content-addressed storage pattern

license.evidence: Architecture pattern, not a copied software package

entries.scope: Immutable original bytes keyed by SHA-256
entries.security: Every write and read is verified against the expected hash
entries.maintenance: Small Shotgun-owned adapter with shared contract tests
entries.replacement: Any local or object-store adapter must pass the same contract suite
entries.recheckTrigger: Hash algorithm change or new storage adapter
